summary: Iter50: Verified daily report expenses + laba_bersih feature. Backend GET /api/reports/daily now returns summary.total_pengeluaran, summary.potongan_platform, summary.laba_bersih and an expenses[] list filtered by date. Frontend Laporan Harian renders stat-pengeluaran, stat-laba-bersih (red when negative) and daily-expenses-table with daily-expense-row-{id}. Add/edit/delete expense correctly reflects in daily report. Monthly report regression confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2422 lines — consider splitting into modules (reports, expenses, auth, etc.) for maintainability.
report_daily uses regex on string created_at; works because expenses store 'YYYY-MM-DDT...' prefix, but a proper date-indexed field would scale better.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ITER50 expenses, all cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response field is 'token' not 'access_token'. Expense create accepts {category,amount,note,date='YYYY-MM-DD'} and stores created_at as 'YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00+00:00'. Daily report at /api/reports/daily?date=... now exposes expenses list + laba_bersih.
